answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if it is caught coordinating duplicate identities to claim the same reward. A sybil attacker can still create many keys, but must lock real capital behind every one; splitting a zephyr, nebula, or garden campaign across identities multiplies the bond required, while detection makes those funds forfeit. The mechanism does not prove personhood: it raises the cost of manufacturing influence and makes large-scale attacks economically risky.
